title: Spinal Cord & Tracts - 50 Soal
description: 50 soal spinal cord: anatomi, tracts, reflex, dan sindrom lesi.

questions.question: How many pairs of spinal nerves are there in humans?
questions.explanation: 31 pasang: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 1 coccygeal. Cervical ada 8 karena C1–C7 keluar di atas vertebra masing-masing dan C8 di bawah C7.

questions.question: In an adult, at which vertebral level does the spinal cord (conus medullaris) usually end?
questions.explanation: Pada dewasa conus medullaris berakhir di L1–L2; pada bayi baru lahir sekitar L3. Di bawahnya hanya ada cauda equina dan filum terminale.

questions.question: A lumbar puncture is planned in an adult. Which interspace is safest to avoid injuring the spinal cord?
questions.explanation: L3–L4 atau L4–L5 berada di bawah ujung cord (L1–L2) dan di dalam lumbar cistern yang hanya berisi cauda equina. Garis yang menghubungkan kedua crista iliaca (Tuffier line) setinggi L4.

questions.question: The cervical enlargement of the spinal cord gives rise to the nerves of which plexus?
questions.explanation: Cervical enlargement (sekitar C4–T1) berisi banyak motor neuron untuk anggota gerak atas melalui brachial plexus. Lumbar enlargement (sekitar T11–S1) untuk lumbosacral plexus ke tungkai.

questions.question: Which type of neuron is found in the dorsal root ganglion?
questions.explanation: DRG berisi badan sel pseudounipolar (first-order sensory neuron) yang dibungkus satellite (capsular) cell. Tidak ada sinaps di DRG.

questions.question: Which fibers are carried by the ventral (anterior) root of a spinal nerve at the T5 level?
options: Both sensory and motor fibers equally
Somatic motor and preganglionic sympathetic fibers
questions.explanation: Ventral root = efferent: akson alpha/gamma motor neuron dari anterior horn, dan pada T1–L2 juga preganglionic sympathetic dari lateral horn (keluar via white ramus communicans). Dorsal root = afferent.

questions.question: The lateral horn (intermediolateral cell column) containing preganglionic sympathetic neurons is found at which spinal segments?
questions.explanation: Lateral horn sympathetic hanya ada di T1–L2 (thoracolumbar outflow). S2–S4 memiliki sacral parasympathetic nucleus, tetapi tidak membentuk lateral horn yang khas.

questions.question: The substantia gelatinosa, important in pain modulation (gate control), corresponds to which Rexed lamina?
questions.explanation: Lamina II = substantia gelatinosa di posterior horn, tempat modulasi nyeri. Lamina I = posteromarginal; VII = intermediate (Clarke nucleus, lateral horn); IX = motor neuron anterior horn; X = sekitar central canal.

questions.question: The nucleus dorsalis (Clarke's column), which gives rise to the posterior spinocerebellar tract, is located at which segments?
questions.explanation: Clarke's column ada di lamina VII segmen C8–L3. Serat dari bawah L3 naik dulu di fasciculus gracilis sebelum bersinaps di sini.

questions.question: A diver suffers a complete spinal cord transection at C2 and stops breathing spontaneously. The motor neurons of which nerve, arising from C3–C5, were cut off from the brain?
questions.explanation: Phrenic nucleus di anterior horn C3–C5 ("C3, 4, 5 keeps the diaphragm alive"). Lesi di atas C3 memutus kontrol volunter dan otomatis ke diaphragm.

questions.question: A patient has urinary retention after injury to the sacral cord. Which segments contain the parasympathetic preganglionic neurons for the bladder?
questions.explanation: Sacral parasympathetic nucleus S2–S4 → pelvic splanchnic nerves → kontraksi detrusor. Sympathetic T10–L2 untuk relaksasi detrusor dan kontraksi internal sphincter.

questions.question: At which spinal levels is the fasciculus cuneatus present?
options: All levels of the spinal cord
Only above T6 (upper thoracic and cervical)
questions.explanation: Fasciculus cuneatus membawa input dari T6 ke atas (lengan, thorax atas), jadi hanya terlihat di segmen di atas T6. Fasciculus gracilis ada di semua level.

questions.question: On a cross-section of the cervical cord, where does the fasciculus gracilis lie relative to the fasciculus cuneatus?
questions.explanation: Serat yang masuk lebih bawah terdorong ke medial oleh serat yang masuk di atasnya. Maka gracilis (tungkai) medial, cuneatus (lengan) lateral.

questions.question: Where is the cell body of the first-order neuron of the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway?
questions.explanation: Neuron 1 di DRG, aksonnya naik ipsilateral di dorsal column tanpa sinaps di spinal cord sampai ke nucleus gracilis/cuneatus di medulla.

questions.question: Where do the fibers of the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway cross the midline?
options: Internal arcuate fibers in the lower medulla (sensory decussation)
Anterior white commissure of the spinal cord
Ventral tegmental decussation in the midbrain
questions.explanation: Akson neuron 2 dari nucleus gracilis & cuneatus menyilang sebagai internal arcuate fibers (sensory decussation) di medulla bawah, lalu naik sebagai medial lemniscus ke VPL.

questions.question: In the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway, where is the third-order neuron?
options: Ventral posteromedial nucleus of the thalamus
Ventral posterolateral nucleus of the thalamus
questions.explanation: Neuron 3 di VPL (tubuh) → posterior limb internal capsule → primary somatosensory cortex (area 3, 1, 2). VPM untuk wajah (trigeminal).

questions.question: Pain from a pinprick on the leg ascends in the lateral spinothalamic tract. Where is the second-order neuron, and where does its axon cross?
questions.explanation: Neuron 2 berada di posterior horn (lamina I, IV–V). Aksonnya menyilang di anterior white commissure lalu naik di lateral funiculus kontralateral.

questions.question: Before crossing, pain and temperature fibers ascend or descend 1–2 segments in which tract?
questions.explanation: Serat nyeri/suhu masuk ke Lissauer tract dan berjalan 1–2 segmen sebelum bersinaps di posterior horn. Karena itu batas defisit pain & temperature pada hemisection berada 1–2 segmen di bawah lesi.

questions.question: Which modality is carried by the anterior spinothalamic tract?
questions.explanation: Anterior spinothalamic = crude touch & pressure. Lateral spinothalamic = pain & temperature. Fine touch, vibration, two-point discrimination melalui DCML.

questions.question: In the brainstem, the anterior and lateral spinothalamic tracts together with the spinotectal tract form which structure?
questions.explanation: Spinal lemniscus = gabungan anterior & lateral spinothalamic dan spinotectal di medulla/pons. Medial lemniscus = DCML; lateral lemniscus = jalur auditory.

questions.question: A patient with an intramedullary (central) cord tumor at T6 has loss of pain below the lesion, but pain in the perianal (sacral) region is preserved. What explains this sacral sparing?
options: Sacral fibers travel in the dorsal column
Sacral fibers lie most medially in the lateral spinothalamic tract
Sacral fibers lie most laterally in the lateral spinothalamic tract
Sacral fibers ascend in the corticospinal tract
questions.explanation: Somatotopi lateral spinothalamic: serat cervical paling medial, sacral paling lateral (dekat permukaan). Lesi yang meluas dari tengah mengenai serat medial dulu, sehingga sensasi sacral tersisa.

questions.question: Which statement about the posterior spinocerebellar tract is correct?
options: It carries conscious proprioception to the cortex
It carries pain from the upper limb
It is uncrossed and enters the cerebellum via the inferior cerebellar peduncle
It crosses twice and enters via the superior cerebellar peduncle
It originates from the accessory cuneate nucleus
questions.explanation: Posterior spinocerebellar: dari Clarke's column, ipsilateral (tidak menyilang), masuk lewat inferior cerebellar peduncle, membawa unconscious proprioception dari tungkai dan badan bawah.

questions.question: The anterior spinocerebellar tract enters the cerebellum through which peduncle?
options: It does not reach the cerebellum
questions.explanation: Anterior spinocerebellar menyilang di spinal cord, naik, lalu masuk lewat superior cerebellar peduncle dan menyilang lagi, sehingga akhirnya tiba di sisi cerebellum yang ipsilateral.

questions.question: Unconscious proprioception from the upper limb reaches the cerebellum via which tract?
questions.explanation: Cuneocerebellar tract (dari accessory/lateral cuneate nucleus di medulla) adalah padanan posterior spinocerebellar untuk lengan, masuk via inferior cerebellar peduncle.

questions.question: Which ascending tract projects to the superior colliculus and is involved in spinovisual reflexes (turning the eyes and head toward a cutaneous stimulus)?
questions.explanation: Spinotectal (ascending) berjalan bersama spinothalamic ke superior colliculus. Tectospinal adalah jalur descending dari superior colliculus ke spinal cord. Jangan tertukar.

questions.question: Where do most (85–90%) corticospinal fibers cross the midline?
options: Pyramidal decussation in the lower medulla
Anterior white commissure at each segment
questions.explanation: Sekitar 85–90% menyilang di pyramidal decussation (medulla bawah) dan turun sebagai lateral corticospinal tract. Sisanya turun sebagai anterior corticospinal tract.

questions.question: Which statement about the anterior corticospinal tract is correct?
options: It originates from the red nucleus
It crosses at the pyramidal decussation
It descends uncrossed and most fibers cross at the segmental level via the anterior white commissure
It ends in the lumbar cord to control the legs
questions.explanation: Anterior corticospinal (~10%) turun ipsilateral di anterior funiculus, lalu sebagian besar menyilang setinggi segmen tujuan. Umumnya hanya sampai cervical/upper thoracic untuk otot aksial.

questions.question: A lacunar infarct produces pure motor hemiparesis of the contralateral arm and leg. Through which part of the internal capsule do corticospinal fibers pass?
questions.explanation: Corticospinal fibers lewat posterior limb internal capsule; corticobulbar di genu. Lesi kecil di sini dapat menyebabkan hemiparesis kontralateral yang berat.

questions.question: In the midbrain, where do the corticospinal fibers descend?
options: Middle three-fifths of the crus cerebri (cerebral peduncle)
questions.explanation: Rute corticospinal: cortex (area 4, 6, 3-1-2) → corona radiata → posterior limb internal capsule → crus cerebri (3/5 tengah) → basis pontis → pyramid medulla → decussation.

questions.question: Which descending tract originates in the red nucleus, crosses in the midbrain, and facilitates flexor muscle tone?
questions.explanation: Rubrospinal: red nucleus → menyilang di ventral tegmental decussation → lateral funiculus. Memfasilitasi otot fleksor, menghambat ekstensor.

questions.question: A sudden flash of light makes a person reflexively turn the head toward it. Which descending tract mediates this?
options: Tectospinal tract from the superior colliculus
Rubrospinal tract from the red nucleus
Vestibulospinal tract from the vestibular nuclei
questions.explanation: Tectospinal: superior colliculus (midbrain) → menyilang di dorsal tegmental decussation → cervical cord. Refleks gerak kepala terhadap stimulus visual.

questions.question: Which tract arises from the lateral vestibular nucleus (Deiters), descends uncrossed, and facilitates extensor (antigravity) muscles?
questions.explanation: Lateral vestibulospinal: ipsilateral, turun di seluruh panjang cord, memfasilitasi otot ekstensor untuk keseimbangan postural. Medial vestibulospinal (via MLF) hanya sampai cervical untuk kontrol kepala-leher.

questions.question: Which descending tract modulates muscle tone and reflex activity and can facilitate or inhibit alpha and gamma motor neurons?
questions.explanation: Reticulospinal (pontine dan medullary) dari reticular formation memodulasi aktivitas alpha & gamma motor neuron, tonus, refleks, dan respirasi.

questions.question: A patient with a lateral cervical cord lesion at C6 develops ptosis, miosis, and anhidrosis on the same side. Interruption of which fibers explains this?
questions.explanation: Serat descending autonomic dari hypothalamus turun ipsilateral di lateral funiculus ke lateral horn T1. Lesi cord di atas T1 → Horner syndrome ipsilateral.

questions.question: Which set of findings indicates an upper motor neuron lesion?
options: Loss of vibration sense and positive Romberg
questions.explanation: UMN: spastic (clasp-knife), hyperreflexia, clonus, Babinski positif, atrofi minimal (disuse). LMN: flaccid, atrofi, fasciculation, areflexia.

questions.question: A patient has weakness of the right hand with marked atrophy of the intrinsic hand muscles, fasciculations, and absent reflexes. Which structure is most likely damaged?
options: Anterior horn cells or ventral roots at C8–T1
questions.explanation: Atrofi, fasciculation, dan areflexia adalah tanda LMN: anterior horn, ventral root, atau saraf perifer. Otot intrinsik tangan dipersarafi C8–T1.

questions.question: Immediately after a complete traumatic transection of the spinal cord at T8, what is expected below the lesion?
options: Normal reflexes with sensory loss only
questions.explanation: Spinal shock: fase akut (hari–minggu) dengan flaccid paralysis, areflexia, atonia kandung kemih di bawah lesi. Setelah itu muncul tanda UMN: spastisitas, hyperreflexia, Babinski.

questions.question: A patient with an S1 radiculopathy has which reflex reduced or absent?
questions.explanation: Segmen refleks: biceps C5–C6, brachioradialis C6, triceps C7, knee jerk L3–L4, ankle jerk S1.

questions.question: In the knee jerk (stretch reflex), which receptor and afferent fiber are activated, and how many synapses are involved?
options: Free nerve ending, C fiber, polysynaptic
Golgi tendon organ, Ib fiber, polysynaptic
questions.explanation: Stretch reflex: muscle spindle → Ia afferent → bersinaps langsung pada alpha motor neuron di anterior horn (monosynaptic). Withdrawal reflex polysynaptic melalui interneuron.

questions.question: A stab wound causes a right hemisection of the spinal cord at T8. Which finding is expected on the RIGHT side below the lesion?
options: Loss of vibration and proprioception with UMN paralysis
Flaccid paralysis of the left leg
questions.explanation: Brown-Séquard: ipsilateral (kanan) hilang DCML (vibrasi, proprioception) dan UMN paralysis; kontralateral (kiri) hilang pain & temperature mulai 1–2 segmen di bawah lesi; LMN ipsilateral setinggi lesi.

questions.question: After aortic surgery, a patient develops sudden bilateral leg paralysis and bilateral loss of pain and temperature below T10, but vibration and joint position sense are preserved. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Anterior spinal artery mendarahi 2/3 anterior cord (anterior horn, corticospinal, spinothalamic). Dorsal column (didarahi posterior spinal arteries) selamat, sehingga vibrasi dan proprioception utuh.

questions.question: A 30-year-old has painless burns on both hands, with loss of pain and temperature over the shoulders and arms in a cape-like distribution, while touch and vibration are preserved. Which structure is damaged first?
questions.explanation: Syringomyelia (kavitas central canal cervical) merusak serat spinothalamic yang menyilang di anterior white commissure → hilang pain & temp bilateral "cape", touch tetap baik (dissociated sensory loss). Jika meluas: LMN tangan (anterior horn).

questions.question: A patient with untreated syphilis has a wide-based gait, lightning pains, loss of vibration and joint position sense, and a positive Romberg test. Which part of the cord is affected?
questions.explanation: Tabes dorsalis: degenerasi dorsal root dan dorsal column → sensory ataxia (Romberg positif karena proprioception hilang dan pasien bergantung pada penglihatan), areflexia, Argyll Robertson pupil.

questions.question: A strict vegan has paresthesias, loss of vibration and position sense, spastic weakness, and a positive Babinski sign. Which tracts are involved?
options: Dorsal columns and lateral corticospinal tracts
questions.explanation: Subacute combined degeneration (defisiensi vitamin B12): demyelinasi dorsal column (vibrasi, proprioception) + lateral corticospinal (tanda UMN), sering disertai neuropati perifer.

questions.question: A 55-year-old has progressive weakness with tongue fasciculations, hand atrophy, hyperreflexia, and Babinski signs. Sensation is entirely normal. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: ALS: degenerasi UMN (lateral corticospinal) dan LMN (anterior horn, motor nuclei brainstem) bersamaan; jalur sensorik utuh.

questions.question: An unvaccinated child develops fever followed by asymmetric flaccid paralysis of one leg with areflexia and normal sensation. Which cells are destroyed?
questions.explanation: Poliomyelitis: poliovirus menyerang anterior horn cell → LMN paralysis asimetris (flaccid, atrofi, areflexia) tanpa gangguan sensorik.

questions.question: A large central L4–L5 disc herniation causes asymmetric bilateral leg weakness, absent ankle reflexes, saddle anesthesia, and urinary retention. What is the diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Di bawah L1–L2 hanya ada nerve roots (cauda equina), jadi lesinya bertipe LMN: flaccid, areflexia, saddle anesthesia, retensi urin. Conus medullaris syndrome lebih simetris dengan gangguan kandung kemih yang lebih dini.

questions.question: Which artery supplies the anterior two-thirds of the spinal cord?
questions.explanation: Anterior spinal artery (dari kedua vertebral artery) mendarahi 2/3 anterior. Dua posterior spinal arteries mendarahi 1/3 posterior (dorsal column).

questions.question: The artery of Adamkiewicz (great anterior radicular artery), which may be injured in aortic surgery, usually arises at which level and on which side?
questions.explanation: Artery of Adamkiewicz biasanya muncul di T9–L2 sisi kiri dan menjadi suplai utama anterior spinal artery bagian thoracolumbar. Cedera saat bedah aorta dapat menyebabkan anterior spinal artery syndrome.

questions.question: A patient with spinal cord compression has a sensory level at the umbilicus. Which dermatome is this?
questions.explanation: Landmark dermatome: T4 puting, T6 xiphoid, T10 umbilicus, L1 ligamentum inguinale, L4 lutut/medial tungkai bawah, S1 sisi lateral kaki.
